info.title: OpenSVC AI agent API
info.description: Conversations with the OpenSVC AI agent. Each backend is served under `/v1/{backend}`: `om3` for the OpenSVC daemons of a cluster, `oc3` for the OpenSVC collector, when the agent is configured with its MCP. A conversation belongs to the backend it was created on and to the identity of its creator. Every backend route authenticates the bearer token before any other work; the agent treats the token as opaque and verifies it through the MCP of the backend.

get.summary: Report the agent liveness, without authentication or upstream call.
Return this OpenAPI document, without authentication.

post.summary: Create an empty conversation for the caller. The request has no body.

400.description: The request carries a body. Codes: `invalid_request`.

409.description: The caller reached the conversation quota of a user, their share of the stored bytes, or the instance its conversation limit. Codes: `conversation_quota`, `conversation_limit`.

get.summary: List the conversations of the caller on this backend, the most recently updated first.
Read a conversation, and the action it waits a decision on, if any.

400.description: The conversation ID is invalid. Codes: `invalid_request`.

404.description: The conversation does not exist, or belongs to another identity or backend. Codes: `conversation_not_found`.

patch.summary: Rename a conversation. A title set here is not replaced by later prompts.

400.description: The body or the title is invalid: empty, longer than 80 characters, or unknown fields. Codes: `invalid_request`.

415.description: The body is not JSON. Codes: `unsupported_media_type`.

404.description: The conversation does not exist, or belongs to another identity or backend. Codes: `conversation_not_found`.

delete.summary: Delete a conversation and its history.

400.description: The conversation ID is invalid. Codes: `invalid_request`.

404.description: The conversation does not exist, or belongs to another identity or backend. Codes: `conversation_not_found`.

409.description: A turn is running in the conversation. Codes: `conversation_busy`.

get.summary: Read the stored messages of a conversation, the most recent page first, for display. Tool calls, tool results and system prompts are never returned.

200.description: One page of messages, at most 1 MiB.

400.description: The query is invalid: unknown parameter, limit out of range or malformed cursor. Codes: `invalid_request`.

413.description: A single stored message exceeds the page size. Codes: `history_message_too_large`.

404.description: The conversation does not exist, or belongs to another identity or backend. Codes: `conversation_not_found`.

put.summary: Give or replace the feedback of the user on a completed turn. The first feedback of a turn copies the turn for review: question, answer and tool calls, bounded. The feedback holds no identity: it stays linked to the turn while the conversation exists, then is kept anonymous until its retention ends.

404.description: The conversation or the turn does not exist, belongs to another identity or backend, or the turn has no feedback to delete. Codes: `feedback_target_not_found`.

400.description: The body or the feedback is invalid, or the turn is not completed. Codes: `invalid_request`, `invalid_feedback`.

409.description: The caller reached their feedback quota, or the instance its feedback limit. Codes: `feedback_quota`, `feedback_limit`.

415.description: The body is not JSON. Codes: `unsupported_media_type`.

delete.summary: Withdraw the feedback of the user on a turn.

404.description: The conversation or the turn does not exist, belongs to another identity or backend, or the turn has no feedback to delete. Codes: `feedback_target_not_found`.

400.description: The conversation or turn ID is invalid. Codes: `invalid_feedback`.

post.summary: Run the agent on the conversation for an AG-UI client (https://docs.ag-ui.com): the last message of the user is the prompt, the tool messages the input ends with answer the calls of the tools of the client the conversation waits on, or resume answers its confirmation. The stream speaks AG-UI.

schema.description: Server-sent events of the AG-UI protocol: each event is written as `data: <event JSON>`, followed by an empty line, without an event name. The run starts with RUN_STARTED and ends with RUN_FINISHED, whose outcome is success or an interrupt for a confirmation, or RUN_ERROR. A RUN_ERROR carries a code: `request_timeout`, `tool_name_conflict`, `conversation_quota` or `conversation_limit` when the turn could not be stored, or `agent_failed`.

400.description: The body is not a RunAgentInput, its threadId is not the conversation, its runId is invalid, the tools of the client are invalid, the tool messages do not answer the calls waiting, the last message is not a text of the user, or the resume is invalid. Codes: `invalid_request`, `invalid_protocol_version`, `unsupported_protocol_version`, `thread_mismatch`, `invalid_run_id`, `invalid_tools`, `invalid_tool_results`, `invalid_prompt`, `invalid_decision`, `invalid_edited_arguments`.

413.description: The body exceeds 4 MiB, or the message of the user 32 KiB. Codes: `request_too_large`, `prompt_too_large`.

415.description: The body is not JSON. Codes: `unsupported_media_type`.

404.description: The conversation does not exist, or belongs to another identity or backend. Codes: `conversation_not_found`.

409.description: The conversation is busy, waits on no such interrupt, or on no call of a tool of the client. Codes: `conversation_busy`, `confirmation_not_pending`, `client_tools_not_pending`.

410.description: The conversation expired, its confirmation did, or its wait on the answers of the client did. Codes: `conversation_expired`, `confirmation_expired`, `client_tools_expired`.

500.description: The conversation operation failed, or the response cannot be streamed. Codes: `conversation_failed`, `snapshot_failed`, `streaming_unavailable`.

get.summary: What the runs route of the backend can do, as an AG-UI AgentCapabilities: SSE streaming, the tools of the MCP and of the client, and the interrupts of confirmations, without edits of the arguments.

The tools of the MCP of the backend the model may be offered: the catalog of the deployment, read with the token of the caller, the same for every user; the rights of the user apply when a tool is called. The tools for the client only, such as the previews, are left out.

200.description: The tools, in the order of the MCP.

502.description: The tools of the MCP could not be read: tools_unavailable.

bearerAuth.description: The access token of the user, in `Authorization: Bearer <token>` only: never in the query string or a cookie. `om3`: the OpenID Connect access token of the user, with the `X-OpenSVC-Cluster-ID` header of the target cluster and, optionally, the `X-OpenSVC-Node` header; a token issued by the daemon is refused. `oc3`: the OpenID Connect access token of the collector user, and no other header.

Backend.name: backend
Backend.description: The backend: `om3`, always served, or `oc3`, served when the agent is configured with the collector MCP.

ClusterID.name: X-OpenSVC-Cluster-ID
ClusterID.description: Required on `om3` routes: the ID of the cluster whose daemon verifies the token. Not read on `oc3` routes.

Node.name: X-OpenSVC-Node
Node.description: Optional on `om3` routes: a routing hint naming a node, never an identity. Not read on `oc3` routes.

TurnID.name: turn_id
TurnID.description: The ID of the turn waiting on a confirmation.

Unauthorized.description: The token is missing, malformed, expired or refused, or a required backend header is missing or invalid. Code: `unauthorized`.

AuthenticationUnavailable.description: The identity of the token cannot be verified now. Code: `authentication_unavailable`.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many agent turns are already running: on the instance, code `too_many_requests`, or of the caller, as many as a user may run at once, code `too_many_user_requests`.

title.description: Empty until the first successful turn, which derives it from its prompt, or until a rename.

expires_at.description: Pushed back by each completed turn.

stored_bytes.description: The size of the stored history.

pending_confirmation.description: The action the conversation waits a decision on. Only the conversation read returns it.

title.description: Control characters are replaced by spaces and whitespace is normalized.

arguments.description: The exact arguments of the call that runs if the user approves it.

argument_types.description: The media types of text arguments, such as `{"yaml": "application/yaml"}`, as the input schema of the tool declares them: show an argument by its type.

editable.description: Whether the user may edit the arguments before approving them, against `input_schema`.

input_schema.description: The input schema of the tool, when the call is editable: the schema of `editedArgs`.

preview.description: What the call would do, as the preview tool of the MCP the tool names in its _meta tells it: a summary, the keys changed, the sections deleted, a content written. Absent for a tool naming no preview.

preview_error.description: Why the preview could not be had; the confirmation stands, the arguments shown.

preview_arguments.description: The edited arguments the preview is of, after a preview asked again; absent when it is of the arguments of the call.

Confirmation.description: A tool call waiting for the decision of the user, which a run resumes with its `id` as the interruptId.

feedback.description: On an assistant message, the feedback of the user on its turn, if any.

steps.description: On the last assistant message of a turn, the calls of its tools.

steps_omitted.description: The steps left out: past 64, or all of them when the message holds in no page with them.

runs.description: On the last assistant message of a turn, its runs. Absent for a turn stored before the times were.

usage.description: On the last assistant message of a turn, its tokens.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as `before` to read the previous page; empty when there is none.

reasons.description: Only with down: does not answer the question, missing information, incorrect or outdated information, hard to understand, expected action not done.

expected.description: What the user would have expected, free text.

RunAgentInput.description: The AG-UI RunAgentInput. The agent reads threadId, runId, the tools of the client, the last message, which must be a message of the user unless the input ends with tool messages answering the calls of the tools of the client, and resume; it keeps its own history, and does not read the other messages, the state, the context or the forwarded properties.

threadId.description: The ID of the conversation of the route.

runId.description: The ID the client gives the run.

content.description: A text, or a list of text parts.

toolCallId.description: On a tool message, the call of a tool of the client it answers.

error.description: On a tool message, why the tool of the client failed.

interruptId.description: The id of the interrupt of the previous run: the confirmation ID.

editedArgs.description: With an approval, the full arguments the user edited, a replacement of those of the call, valid against the input schema of the tool. Only for an interrupt whose metadata is editable.
The full arguments the user edited: the preview of the call is asked again for them; nothing runs, and the call waits again under a new interrupt.

tools.description: The tools of the client, offered to the model and run by the client: a name of 1 to 64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, not a tool of the MCP or of the agent, a description of at most 4 KiB, parameters of at most 64 KiB, 256 KiB in all.

protocolVersion.description: The version of AG-UI the client speaks, MAJOR.MINOR: a newer minor of the line 1 is served with a warning, another major line refused.

AgentCapabilities.description: The AG-UI AgentCapabilities of the agent: identity, transport, tools, humanInTheLoop and multimodal groups.

DisplayStep.description: One call of a tool of a turn, in the order of the turn.

arguments.description: The arguments of the call; null past 16 KiB, or past 192 KiB for the turn, with arguments_omitted.

started_at.description: Milliseconds since the epoch, on the clock of the agent: the timestamp the stream carried. Absent for a turn stored before the times were.

ended_at.description: Milliseconds since the epoch, on the clock of the agent: the timestamp the stream carried. Absent for a turn stored before the times were.

status.description: failed: an error of the tool; rejected: by the user, the call did not run; interrupted: no result.

result_excerpt.description: The first 4 KiB of the result, cut on a character.

refusal.description: The text of an error of the tool, at most 16 KiB.

edited_arguments.description: The arguments the call ran with, when the user edited it before approving it.

DisplayRun.description: A run of a turn, the waits for a decision left out.

started_at.description: Milliseconds since the epoch, on the clock of the agent, when the run started.

ended_at.description: Milliseconds since the epoch, on the clock of the agent, when the run ended; absent if not recorded.

Tool.description: A tool the assistant may call.

title.description: Its human title, its name when it declares none; at most 200 bytes, cut on a character with an ellipsis past them.

summary.description: The first sentence of its description, up to a period followed by a space or a line break; at most 512 bytes, cut on a character with an ellipsis past them; empty when it has none.

needs_confirmation.description: A call of the tool waits for the confirmation of the user: a tool not read-only, unless it declares itself not destructive.
